$comment: Blueprints and builder NPCs (WORK_QUEUE item 56, docs/BLUEPRINTS.md): a placed structure shown as ghost blocks, built by players holding Place and by builder NPCs. `limits`: the most blueprints a world holds (`perWorld`). `player`: one piece every `paceMs` while Place is held aiming into a blueprint, the panel's most block rows (`panelRows`). `ghost`: the most ghost faces drawn per blueprint (`faceCap`). `builder`: the creature that builds (`creature`, shared/creatures), one piece every `paceS` seconds with unlimited blocks, standing within `reachM` of its cell to place it, spawned at a blueprint with a player within `nearM` m and none of its builders yet (at most `perBlueprint`). `catalog`: the repository's blueprints offered in the Blueprints list (structure names, shared/structures). Run `node shared/blueprints/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/blueprints.gen.rs is stale. `towns` (B4): town sites per face from the world seed, one at most per `spacingM` grid cell at a seeded point within `jitter` × half a cell of its centre (`attempts` points tried in order, the first that suits), on dry land `heightM` [min, max] m above sea level whose ground rises at most `maxSlopeDeg` across `footprintM`; founded (its plan's blueprints placed, each on the ground under its anchor) once a living player is within `foundM` m and its ground is loaded. A plan (`plans`, picked by `weight` per site): its blueprints, each a structure, its anchor's offset from the site `at` [x, z] m and its `turn` (quarter turns).
